environment: isolated development preview; public read-only snapshot

reviewed_sources.finding: Research and prevention plan; imported product is a Spanish webinar link label, not a named outbreak product.

FDA page taxonomy says Food & Beverages, but title and announcement describe epinephrine injection. Stated recall reasons are particulate matter and lack of sterility assurance. Wording lead to was misclassified as chemical lead contamination.
Credited WPLG Local 10 reporting from the sheriff news conference supports the death and injury attribution in the sampled original Noteworthy update.
Restored the exact complete source-page headline. Product description itself is truncated in FDA summary; do not reconstruct its missing ending.

limitations: A public publication snapshot is not independent verification of every record.
No authenticated FDA source documents, raw ingestion logs or live editorial records were accessed.
Lead video upstream creator/rights credit is not present in the public record.
The source API returns at most 200 indexed records; this snapshot is not an exhaustive historical archive.
Older public earthquake assets contain algorithmic forecasts; those are not official agency evidence and must not be rendered as such.
